narration:0:1460131001:1.text: Following a thorough and thoughtful discussion, the precise schedule, overarching theme, and governing rules are all duly established.
narration:0:1460131001:1.source_cn: 经历了漫长的讨论后，你们终于确定了具体的赛程、主题和规则。

narration:1:1460131002:0.text: Then, you all hand invitation letters to Dolly, who cheerfully sets off to deliver them to old friends waiting far and wide.
narration:1:1460131002:0.source_cn: 紧接着，你们将信件交给多莉，分发给了各地等待已久的朋友们。

narration:3:1460131003:0.text: Deep within the heart of the Dark Forest, one steps forward, eager to face the trials that await...
narration:3:1460131003:0.source_cn: 在薄暮丛林，有人跃跃欲试……

say:6:1460131004:1.text: It's time I set off to Holistone to face the warriors there.
say:6:1460131004:1.source_cn: 那么，我就先出发去尝试下圣石镇那边的挑战了。

say:7:1460131005:1.text: Wait! Why are you in such a hurry?

say:8:1460131006:1.text: Like I said before... Since you're going to help us hold the qualifying matches, we're going to treat you like any other participant.
say:8:1460131006:1.source_cn: 之前都说过了，既然你不来负责主持，那就一视同仁！

say:9:1460131007:1.text: Before you leave, you need to get a battle writ from us first!
say:9:1460131007:1.source_cn: 在巡礼各地前，先从我们这里拿到凭证才行！

narration:13:1460131009:1.text: And in Holistone, someone is fanning the flames...
narration:13:1460131009:1.source_cn: 而在圣石镇，有人煽风点火……

say:17:1460131010:1.text: I don't plan on organizing any matches or competing.
say:17:1460131010:1.source_cn: 我是不打算组织赛事，也不打算参赛啦。

say:18:1460131011:1.text: So, how about you two lovely ladies screen the contestants?
say:18:1460131011:1.source_cn: 所以，就拜托二位女士来筛选这些参赛者如何？

say:19:1460131012:1.text: If they want to face Magister Merlin, they have to get through you.
say:19:1460131012:1.source_cn: 要想见到梅林大人，就必须通过你们这关——之类的。
say:19:1460131012:1.male: If they want to face Magister Merlin, they have to get through you.
say:19:1460131012:1.female: If they want to face Magister Merlin, they have to get through you.

say:20:1460131013:1.text: This is a huge responsibility, Valen, but I will do my best!
say:20:1460131013:1.source_cn: 责任重大！维伦先生，我会尽力而为！

say:22:1460131015:1.text: Rather than listening to him, it'd be more fun to singe his boots a bit...
say:22:1460131015:1.source_cn: 与其说那种无聊的理由，还不如“我想烧掉出现在我眼前会说...

say:23:1460131016:1.text: Miss Mirael, you don't have to act like the Scarlet Sorceress all the time... especially among friends...
say:23:1460131016:1.source_cn: 米瑞尔小姐在大部分时间都还是灰烬魔女的做派呢……

narration:26:1460131017:1.text: Over at the Golden Guest Inn, someone is bragging louder and louder...
narration:26:1460131017:1.source_cn: 在客金旅店里，有人正在吹嘘——

say:28:1460131018:1.text: Like I said! When the time comes, I'll take you all on my ship, and we'll sail to the desert!
say:28:1460131018:1.source_cn: 所以我说！我到时候就会开着船，带你们去沙漠！

say:29:1460131019:1.text: What did you say? How would I know if there's a port in the desert?! Anyway, for this "pilgrimage", I'll be your examiner!
say:29:1460131019:1.source_cn: 话说沙漠有没有港口啊……不管这个了！总之这什么巡礼，我...

say:31:1460131020:1.text:
Ow! 
What was that for, Lucca?
say:31:1460131020:1.source_cn: 哎哟！好疼！\n卢卡，你打我干嘛？

say:33:1460131021:1.text: For your big mouth! Me and Sonja are going to be the examiners!
say:33:1460131021:1.source_cn: 打的就是你，考官是我和索尼娅！

say:34:1460131022:1.text: We've just finalized the match schedule. You follow this schedule. Beat all the matches before tomorrow and get the battle writ from Rustport!
say:34:1460131022:1.source_cn: 我们刚刚定好了赛程列表，你，照着这个表，明天之前给我打...

say:36:1460131024:1.text: Yes, you're the one who said you were going to sail to the desert with contestants.
say:36:1460131024:1.source_cn: 那当然，谁让你自己说，要给参赛选手们开船！

say:37:1460131025:0.text: Well, win, get the battle writ, and set sail!
say:37:1460131025:0.source_cn: 拿完证明就去整备船只和补给，快，动起来！

narration:40:1460131026:1.text: Over at the Radinov Manor, some are feeling uneasy...
narration:40:1460131026:1.source_cn: 在庄园的旧址，也有人正在忐忑不安……

say:42:1460131027:1.text: Thank you very much for participating in the tournament today... No.
say:42:1460131027:1.source_cn: 非常感谢诸位今日愿意来参赛……不对。

say:43:1460131028:1.text: Thank you all for coming here today to participate in this regional qualifier... That doesn't sound right either.
say:43:1460131028:1.source_cn: 感谢诸位今日到场，参加这场预选赛……唔，还是不对。

say:46:1460131029:0.text: Carolina... You've been... reciting... for hours...

say:49:1460131030:0.text: Ah, Igor... I must need to instruct him yet again in the art of decorum, lest he disgrace us upon the stage.
say:49:1460131030:0.source_cn: 唔，我得教教伊戈尔，别在台上太失礼。

say:50:1460131031:0.text: Igor, I'll teach you how to properly greet the public... Igor? Where did you go?
say:50:1460131031:0.source_cn: 伊戈尔！过来，跟我学问候……伊戈尔，人呢！

say:53:1460131032:0.text: The Sunlit Showdown... So many designs scattered across so many locations... What am I to do?
say:53:1460131032:0.source_cn: ……烈阳，还有这么多地方不同的设计……真会给人找麻烦。

say:54:1460131033:0.text: Okay, this one for the Dark Forest and Holistone... This is for Rustport...
say:54:1460131033:0.source_cn: 薄暮丛林，圣石镇……这个是，锈锚港……

narration:57:1460131034:1.text: Out in the vast desert, the atmosphere is searing with anticipation...
narration:57:1460131034:1.source_cn: 而在沙漠中，氛围已然无比火热——

say:59:1460131035:1.text: I am grateful for your guidance and care during this time
say:59:1460131035:1.source_cn: 感谢你这段时间对我的照顾和引领。
say:59:1460131035:1.male: I am grateful for your guidance and care during this time
say:59:1460131035:1.female: I am grateful for your guidance and care during this time

say:60:1460131036:1.text: Under your watchful eye and steady hand, I have learned much.
say:60:1460131036:1.source_cn: 在你的指引与展现下，我积累了大量的灵感与经验。
say:60:1460131036:1.male: Under your watchful eye and steady hand, I have learned much.
say:60:1460131036:1.female: Under your watchful eye and steady hand, I have learned much.

say:61:1460131037:1.text: What has long brewed in silence now releases a gentle fragrance.
say:61:1460131037:1.source_cn: 这份深沉的酝酿如今已然散发出了醇厚的芬芳。
say:61:1460131037:1.male: What has long brewed in silence now releases a gentle fragrance.
say:61:1460131037:1.female: What has long brewed in silence now releases a gentle fragrance.

say:62:1460131038:1.text: My martial arts are yet unripe, but the roots have taken hold, and the fruit has begun to form.
say:62:1460131038:1.source_cn: 尽管我所悟到的武技还不成熟，但确实已经得到了成果。
say:62:1460131038:1.male: My martial arts are yet unripe, but the roots have taken hold, and the fruit has begun to form.
say:62:1460131038:1.female: My martial arts are yet unripe, but the roots have taken hold, and the fruit has begun to form.

say:63:1460131039:1.text: I owe this to you. Among all the steps I've taken in this foreign land, crossing paths with you has been my greatest blessing.
say:63:1460131039:1.source_cn: 这都是多亏了你——能够与你相遇，是我这次异国之行最为幸...
say:63:1460131039:1.male: I owe this to you. Among all the steps I've taken in this foreign land, crossing paths with you has been my greatest blessing.
say:63:1460131039:1.female: I owe this to you. Among all the steps I've taken in this foreign land, crossing paths with you has been my greatest blessing.

choice_prompt:64:1460131039.text: I owe this to you. Among all the steps I've taken in this foreign land, crossing paths with you has been my greatest blessing.
choice_prompt:64:1460131039.source_cn: 这都是多亏了你——能够与你相遇，是我这次异国之行最为幸运的事。
choice_prompt:64:1460131039.male: I owe this to you. Among all the steps I've taken in this foreign land, crossing paths with you has been my greatest blessing.
choice_prompt:64:1460131039.female: I owe this to you. Among all the steps I've taken in this foreign land, crossing paths with you has been my greatest blessing.

say:65:1460131040:1.text: Yes. I now set forth the battlegrounds. My aim is clear. I will earn my qualification for the main tournament.
say:65:1460131040:1.source_cn: 当然，我这就打算启程，按照指引前往巡礼地点进行比赛，目...
say:65:1460131040:1.male: Yes. I now set forth the battlegrounds. My aim is clear. I will earn my qualification for the main tournament.
say:65:1460131040:1.female: Yes. I now set forth the battlegrounds. My aim is clear. I will earn my qualification for the main tournament.

say:66:1460131041:1.text: Eironn and I have agreed to meet at the Sunlit Showdown. There, we shall clash in the true trial of our skills.
say:66:1460131041:1.source_cn: 我与埃隆已经约好了，到时会在大赛上相见。
say:66:1460131041:1.male: Eironn and I have agreed to meet at the Sunlit Showdown. There, we shall clash in the true trial of our skills.
say:66:1460131041:1.female: Eironn and I have agreed to meet at the Sunlit Showdown. There, we shall clash in the true trial of our skills.

choice_prompt:67:1460131041.text: Eironn and I have agreed to meet at the Sunlit Showdown. There, we shall clash in the true trial of our skills.
choice_prompt:67:1460131041.source_cn: 我与埃隆已经约好了，到时会在大赛上相见。
choice_prompt:67:1460131041.male: Eironn and I have agreed to meet at the Sunlit Showdown. There, we shall clash in the true trial of our skills.
choice_prompt:67:1460131041.female: Eironn and I have agreed to meet at the Sunlit Showdown. There, we shall clash in the true trial of our skills.

say:68:1460131042:1.text: This is wonderful news. My only regret has been that so much time has passed without the honor of competing against you.
say:68:1460131042:1.source_cn: 那就太好了，这么长时间一直没有能与你较量，可以说是最大...
say:68:1460131042:1.male: This is wonderful news. My only regret has been that so much time has passed without the honor of competing against you.
say:68:1460131042:1.female: This is wonderful news. My only regret has been that so much time has passed without the honor of competing against you.

say:69:1460131043:1.text: Allow me a little more time to refine my skills, and I will present my perfect form at the main tournament.
say:69:1460131043:1.source_cn: 那么，请让我再磨练一阵，在大赛上，我会展现出完美的姿态！
say:69:1460131043:1.male: Allow me a little more time to refine my skills, and I will present my perfect form at the main tournament.
say:69:1460131043:1.female: Allow me a little more time to refine my skills, and I will present my perfect form at the main tournament.

narration:71:1460131044:0.text: The relentless sun spreads its smoldering light across the land, the air thick with scorching heat.
narration:71:1460131044:0.source_cn: 灿烂的阳光下伴随着灼热的温度洒遍大地。
